name: Blockwerk
summary: Blockwerk is a factory-building and automation game set in an endless, procedurally generated block world. Players control a small builder robot that tracks down resources with a scanner, mines iron, copper, limestone and coal, and processes them by hand at a workbench before automating production with drills, conveyor belts, smelters, constructors and a power grid. Progression runs through milestones and a research tree, and players can build their own structures from blocks, windows and plates. The game supports single-player and online co-op for up to 8 players.
